about: The overseer's operative numbers, as data (Coach Player synthesis convergence #10: thresholds live as data with provenance — a value is a guess until it is swept or shaded by evidence). Mirrored by the built-in defaults in thresholds.js, which are what the runtime falls back to when this file cannot be read; tools/m1-test.mjs asserts the two agree on every value. When a number changes, change it here AND in docs/OVERSEER-NUMBERS.md (coach-player repo) AND in thresholds.js, and say so in the commit. Full provenance for every row lives in coach-player docs/OVERSEER-NUMBERS.md.

harvest.about: Authored harvest values (synthesis: MiniMax's authored map for V1; each host game authors its own — a port tax). Anti-tautology rule: every value is a property of the WATER, defensible without reference to any objective — WRECK scores 0.0 despite being a listed objective; the shoal scores 2.4 because the water is good.
